title: Validate Validator Selftests
description: Draft command semantic instance for the planted-defect and fixture selftest validator gate.
purpose: Validate that repository validator rules catch their planted defects and expected negative fixture failures with stable rule coverage.
outputs: JSON validator result on standard output
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates a validator rule, planted defect, fixture, schema, or expected rule ID no longer behaves as declared. Selftest output cannot itself authorize schema activation or implementation extraction.
aiGuidance: Use this command to prove validator guard coverage before relying on validator changes. Do not use selftest success to invent product semantics.
